name: search_docs
description: Search Jarvis internal documentation for answers about capabilities, tool parameters, settings, and features. Use when user asks informational questions like: 'what video sizes can I generate?', 'how long can music be?', 'what image styles are available?', 'how does memory work?'. This is Q&A about Jarvis capabilities - NOT for executing tools. Returns documentation excerpts that answer the question.

query.description: Natural language question about Jarvis capabilities, tool parameters, or features. Examples: 'video generation duration and sizes', 'music generation styles', 'image aspect ratios'

topic.description: Optional: focus search on a specific topic. Default 'all' searches everything.

limit.description: Number of documentation excerpts to return (default 5)
